title: Gratitude Streak Break Detector
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log
| stats latest(_time) as last_gratitude, count as total_entries
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_gratitude)/86400,0), at_risk=if(days_since>=2,1,0)
description: Shows when a gratitude habit has gone quiet for a couple of days and may need a nudge.
value: Small, positive habits are easy to drop during stressful weeks; detecting the break early is better than restarting from scratch later.
implementation: Send gratitude entries to `index=personal`; alert when the gap since the last entry passes your threshold.
visualization: Single-value tile of days since last gratitude log.
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk**: Splunk Enterprise ≥9.0 or Splunk Cloud — a single-instance home lab is fine. Create `index=personal` with 90–365 day retention (`indexes.conf`).
• **HEC token**: Settings → Data Inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token → index `personal`. Store the token in your connector's environment (never commit it to git).
• **Upstream product**: Personal HEC index — HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.
• **Subcategory context**: Mind, Mood & Journaling — typical feeds: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`)..
• **Sourcetypes in this search**: `gratitude:log`.
• **Network**: The connector host must reach both the vendor API/MQTT broker and your Splunk HEC port (8088/tcp).

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

Route **Personal HEC index** events into `index=personal` with `sourcetype=gratitude:log`.

**Collection method:** HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.

**Reference endpoint / path:** `POST https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event`.

**Suggested poll interval:** depends on upstream connector.

**Key fields to extract:** `sourcetype-specific — see search filters`.

**Typical connector stack:** Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs..

**Author notes:** Send gratitude entries to `index=personal`; alert when the gap since the last entry passes your threshold.


Example HEC payload shape:

```json
{"index": "personal", "sourcetype": "gratitude:log", "event": { ... vendor fields ... }}
```

Verify ingestion with:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log earliest=-24h | head 20
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

This search implements **Gratitude Streak Break Detector** over `personal` data (primarily `sourcetype=gratitude:log`) across the full search range. It applies numeric thresholds on `days_since` (>= 2) after latest — tune these constants to your household baseline.

**Fields this search depends on:** `days_since`. Confirm each is populated before scheduling alerts.

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log
| stats latest(_time) as last_gratitude, count as total_entries
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_gratitude)/86400,0), at_risk=if(days_since>=2,1,0)
```

## Step 3 — Validate

**(a) Compare to vendor UI:** Splunk Search → index=personal | stats count by sourcetype. Totals for the same day/week should match within connector lag (usually one poll interval).

**(b) Field presence:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log earliest=-7d
| head 50
| table days_since
```

Every column the detection uses should be non-null on recent rows.

**(c) Volume sanity:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log earliest=-30d
| timechart span=1d count
```

Flatlines usually mean a broken token, expired OAuth refresh, or HEC URL change.

**(d) Threshold calibration:** Profile `days_since` before alerting:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log earliest=-30d
| stats perc50(days_since) AS p50 perc90(days_since) AS p90 perc99(days_since) AS p99 max(days_since) AS hi
```

## Step 4 — Operationalize

Create a companion dashboard titled `UC-25.31.13: Personal evidence` with the following panel layout:

**Panel 1 — Single-Value Tile Of Days Since Last Gratitude Log (the key fields):** Configure according to standard Splunk visualization patterns for this panel type.


Time picker defaults: set to last 30 days with named presets for 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, and 1y — the auditor needs all five windows without retyping. Enable scheduled PDF export for the full dashboard on the regulation's reporting cadence.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Personal HEC index — no Personal HEC index events / missing fields:** If `gratitude:log` stops updating, re-check HEC token, index `personal`, and firewall to port 8088. Search `index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector` for rejection reasons. Confirm the Personal HEC index connector script is still running (`systemctl status` or cron log).

**Personal HEC index — NULL values in extracted fields:** The Personal HEC index JSON export shape drifted — compare a raw event (`index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log | head 1 | spath`) against the field names in Step 2. Re-map in the connector before changing the SPL.

**Personal HEC index — API error / auth denied (401/403):** Refresh tokens expire on most consumer APIs — re-authorize the scripted input, update `passwords.conf` / env vars, and verify the vendor developer app is not in sandbox mode.

**Personal HEC index — endpoint timeout / HTTP 429 throttling:** Back off the poll interval in the connector; Personal HEC index APIs often cap requests per 15 minutes on free tiers.

**Stale dashboard:** Confirm the saved search `dispatch.earliest_time` covers enough history for your `aggregation` buckets.
